Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

VisualWebArena: Evaluating Multimodal Agents on Realistic Visual Web Tasks (2401.13649v1) · paper method: The VisualWebArena human evaluation uses seven college students familiar with commercial site analogues; participants who helped create tasks were not assigned their own tasks.
